scope.summary: Add the BodyKit REST routes to the Tailor API per Section 13.16 (BK-16.6 API surface): bodies CRUD, recipes CRUD, channel value get/set, and export trigger under the existing tailor router in src/api/tailor.rs, returning typed JSON navigable by prefixed id (BDY-/BRC-/BCH-) so no-context models traverse body state without chat history (REQ-043 addressability).
acceptance_criteria: Routes wired: POST /tailor/bodies, GET/PATCH/DELETE /tailor/bodies/{body_id}; POST /tailor/recipes, GET/DELETE /tailor/recipes/{recipe_id}; GET+PUT /tailor/bodies/{body_id}/channels/{channel_key}; POST /tailor/bodies/{body_id}/export.
All request/response bodies are typed serde structs (no serde_json::Value passthrough); BodySpec responses embed schema_id 'hsk.tailor.body_spec@1' and canonical prefixed ids.

Channel PUT validates channel_key against bodykit_channel_registry and the value against the channel's declared range including design_max (TAI-BK-034: beyond design_max is rejected); unknown keys return 404, out-of-range values 422 with the allowed range in the error body.
Every mutating route emits its TAILOR_BODY_* event and writes through guarded storage; a route-level test proves event-before-row ordering.
Length values on the API surface are cm (LLM surface) converted at the boundary to mm authority via the MT-479 helpers.
scope.risk_if_missed: Without typed id-navigable routes, models reach BodyKit only through ad-hoc tooling, breaking the model-first contract Tailor is built on and blocking every BkModelApi MT downstream.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
